data.long_meaning: In Islamic tradition, Fattahah is a name derived from the Arabic root ‘f-t-t’, meaning ‘to open’. It is often used to describe someone who opens the way for others or opens the doors to success. In the Quran, there is a verse where Allah (SWT) is described as ‘Al-Fattah’ – the Opener. Fattahah is a beautiful and spiritual name for a baby girl, evoking images of the gateway to knowledge, wisdom, and success.
